source: Re:Flora native Vulkan renderer, local development captures
rights: Internal project research screenshots. Underlying game assets retain their existing rights; this bundle grants no separate redistribution license.
capture_commands: Release --cozy-home --hidden --mute, isolated RE_FLORA_ROOT; fixed camera poses in ../data.json. Performance: --perf --screenshot window-low scene.png --screenshot-delay 20 --auto-exit 21. Motion: --denoiser-bench window-low motion.toml --denoiser-bench-warmup-frames 180 --denoiser-bench-frames 24 --denoiser-bench-camera-motion --auto-exit 20. 4K: --windowed, X11 WINIT_X11_SCALE_FACTOR=3, WAYLAND_DISPLAY/WAYLAND_SOCKET removed. GUI experiments: glass_reduced_sampling=false for quad; true with glass_sampling_pattern=0/1/2/3 for center/view/screen-pair/diagonal-pair.
raw_capture_binary_sha256: Not archived for the temporary readback-instrumented build; final uninstrumented build is hashed above. Shader sampling/transport sources were unchanged during probe removal.
